items.problem: Bootstrap omitted externally linked UWP project content.
items.evidence: lessons.json dev_agent_struggles[0]; session-log turn 2 copied 4 files and turns 7-12 manually recovered linked SharedContent.
items.root_cause: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 copied the directory tree but did not evaluate Include + Link project items.
items.change: Resolve common linked-item properties, copy supported Compile/ApplicationDefinition/Page/Content/None items to their Link paths, include them in migration mapping, and fail on unresolved links.
items.expected_effect: Shared UWP shells, styles, helpers, and assets enter the normal namespace rewrite and TODO triage automatically.
items.falsifiable_check: Running bootstrap on NfcProvisioner copies 17 items and creates App.xaml, App.xaml.cs, MainPage.xaml, MainPage.xaml.cs, Styles/Styles.xaml, and linked Assets without manual discovery.

items.problem: Manifest checks missed schema ordering and did not enforce the existing WinUI entry-point rule.
items.evidence: skill-defects.json item 1 and skill-coverage-gaps.json item 0; turn 22 registration error and migration-score.json candidate_launchable=false.
items.root_cause: Validation checked Desktop target and runFullTrust presence only, allowing both an invalid child order and UWP App entry point.
items.change: Reject capabilities after DeviceCapability, reject Application EntryPoint values other than $targetentrypoint$, and document AppX capability ordering.
items.expected_effect: Registration-breaking manifest defects fail before runtime and point directly to the existing manifest checklist.
items.falsifiable_check: The trial manifest fails validation for EntryPoint="NfcProvisioner.App"; moving rescap:Capability after DeviceCapability independently fails with an ordering diagnostic.

items.problem: An unavailable smoke launch could satisfy the mandatory validation gate.
items.evidence: skill-defects.json item 2; turn 40 validator PASS followed by scorer candidate_launchable=false.
items.root_cause: Validate-UwpMigration mapped unavailable to WARN even though no live process had been observed.
items.change: Map unavailable launch status to FAIL and clarify in SKILL.md that only an observed running process satisfies runtime validation.
items.expected_effect: Environment, registration, and output-lock failures remain distinguishable from crashes but cannot produce false completion.
items.falsifiable_check: A resources.pri lock or any no-AUMID/no-PID result makes Validate-UwpMigration exit 1 rather than report PASS.
